description:
This file is a PHP source code defining the 'Edit' class within the Opencart ront ramework
ameSpace for account editing functionality. It includes methods for displaying and processing the account edit form, validation, and saving customer data within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Class responsible for handling customer account editing, including displaying the edit form, validation, and updating customer data in the database. It extends the base Controller class of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the account edit page. Loads language resources, checks customer authentication, prepares breadcrumbs, loads customer data, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the AJAX POST request to save the edited customer data. Validates input, updates customer info, handles errors, and returns JSON response.
